item.title: Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow Set to Return to Inverness in 2026
item.description: The Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow is set to return to Inverness in February 2026, bringing riders, police, fire service and safety experts together for a free evening focused on safer riding, real world collisions and practical skills for Highland motorcyclists.The post Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow Set to Return to Inverness in 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Welcomes Cherry Blossom Gift From Japan Ahead of Christmas
item.description: Orkney has become the UK’s most northerly recipient of Sakura cherry blossom trees through a Japan UK friendship project, with 30 trees being planted across schools and communities and locals invited to share photos ahead of a spring celebration.The post Orkney Welcomes Cherry Blossom Gift From Japan Ahead of Christmas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Angus Òg Hits The Big Screen as Beloved Highland Rogue Comes to Life on New Year’s Day
item.description: Angus Òg is heading to the screen for the first time as a new BBC Alba documentary explores the life and legacy of cartoonist Ewen Bain, celebrating one of Scotland’s most loved Highland characters and the satire that shaped a generation.The post Angus Òg Hits The Big Screen as Beloved Highland Rogue Comes to Life on New Year’s Day appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: No Place for Hate Campaign Launches in Inverness With United Community Backing
item.description: A new No Place for Hate campaign has launched in Inverness, backed by police, public services and local businesses, aiming to raise awareness of hate crime, encourage reporting, and send a clear message that discrimination and abuse have no place in the city.The post No Place for Hate Campaign Launches in Inverness With United Community Backing appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Bikeability Champion Honoured for Two Decades of Safer Cycling in Orkney
item.description: An Orkney road safety officer has been nationally recognised for over 20 years of dedication to Bikeability training, with judges praising her role in achieving full delivery across Orkney and helping generations of children cycle safely and confidently.The post Bikeability Champion Honoured for Two Decades of Safer Cycling in Orkney appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Demands STV Reverse North News Cuts After Public Backlash
item.description: SNP MSP Jackie Dunbar has urged STV to fully reverse plans to axe North of Scotland news, warning that watered down proposals still mean job losses and the end of meaningful regional coverage despite strong public and political opposition.The post SNP Demands STV Reverse North News Cuts After Public Backlash appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Community Toy Appeal Delivers Christmas Magic to Children in Highland Hospital Care
item.description: A community toy appeal led by Highland businesses has delivered festive cheer to children receiving hospital care in Inverness, with donations supporting families helped by The Archie Foundation during what can be one of the toughest times of the year.The post Community Toy Appeal Delivers Christmas Magic to Children in Highland Hospital Care appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Record £14m Drugs Seizure Sends Clear Message Ahead of Christmas
item.description: Police Scotland has seized nearly £14m worth of drugs in a record pre Christmas week, with major recoveries across the country targeting organised crime groups and significantly disrupting the supply of cocaine and other controlled substances.The post Record £14m Drugs Seizure Sends Clear Message Ahead of Christmas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: AES Solar Rebrands as aes renewables With Long Term Focus on Highland Growth
item.description: A Moray based renewable energy firm has rebranded as aes renewables following major investment and expansion, signalling long term confidence in the Highlands and a renewed commitment to supporting communities, skills and sustainable energy solutions across the north of Scotland.The post AES Solar Rebrands as aes renewables With Long Term Focus on Highland Growth appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: More Than 100,000 Marine Giants Recorded in Scotland’s Seas in Record Year
item.description: More than 100,000 whales, dolphins and other marine giants were recorded in Scotland’s seas during 2025, as public wildlife sightings reached a record high and offered new insight into how marine species use our waters.The post More Than 100,000 Marine Giants Recorded in Scotland’s Seas in Record Year appeared first on The Highland Times.
